lore.bio:
Before his birth, it was foretold that Seer would bring pain and suffering to the world--and the night he was born, a meteor barreled across the sky and struck his world’s moon. It was considered a bad omen, and when the pale blue eyes of Obi Edolasim opened, his community saw a cursed child. His parents did not; they loved him unconditionally because they saw the true empathic, creative soul of their son. They even supported him when he was drawn to the theatricality of the Arenas - a series of underground fighting competitions - where he could express himself fully. What is a fight, if not an adversarial dance?
At first, the crowds felt unsure of him. But over time, with each victory, the power inside him grew, and with it, his strength in the Arena. And as his reputation began to precede him, a strange thing happened… The people in the crowd who were downtrodden, outcast, and forgotten—they saw themselves in Seer. Soon, throngs of people would come out just to see him fight—cheering Seer on as their champion. 
This legend from the Arenas made his way to the Apex Games as an icon of the shunned, the unaccepted, and the unabashedly original. Still, there are those that continue to blame him for the deterioration of the moon of his homeworld Boreas for many reasons – his curse, his underwhelming aid to the people of Boreas, and now for bringing the Games to the moon. He fights on to make things right, however he can.

For more information on Seer's story, see Seer (character).

passive.name: Heart Seeker
passive.description: Hear and visualize the heartbeats of enemies within 75m when aiming down sights, if enemies are beyond this range the marker turns blue and pulsates with less intensity. Insight duration has been increased.

tactical.name: Focus of Attention
tactical.description: Summon micro-drones to emit a delayed blast that goes through walls silencing and revealing enemies, dealing damage while slowing them for 1s. The blast now has a range of 60m and fires ~30% faster. Activation delay is reduced to 1.2 seconds. Healthbars persist on silenced enemies for the duration of Silence.

ultimate.name: Exhibit
ultimate.description: Create a sphere of micro-drones that reveal the location of enemies moving quickly or firing their weapons within. Enemies hit by this ability are slowed for 2.5s and highlighted with threat outline to Seer and his teammates when in line of sight. You can double jump while inside the sphere.

tactics.playstyle: A micro-information expert, Seer shines in prolonged indoor fights. He cancels enemy heals and revives with his tactical, creating massive windows of vulnerability.

left.name: Lasting Beat
left.description: Ult show enemy for 5s after leaving the zone.

details: [Tactical] Buff -> Focus of Attention: decreased activation delay to 1.2s (was 1.4).
[Perks] New -> Ultimate Cooldown: reduces Ult Cooldown by 30s
[Tactical] Fix -> Removed Heal Cancel, Revive Cancel, and Respawn Beacon Interaction Interrupt.
[Tactical] Buff -> Highlighted with threat outline to Seer and his teammates when in line of sight.
[Ultimate] Nerf -> Removed Diamond Scan Markers on Enemy Movement. Only shows footsteps of players moving in the zone. Only appear with enemy gunfire for 1.25s.
